rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=18, batch_size=1, lr=0.00011, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-5 (one knob vs iter-1 best). NUMBERS: iter-1 hr=0.3009 (BEST: n_bands=6,n_outer=2,motion_window=2,motion_range=8,epochs=12,lr=1.1e-4); iter-2 0.2805 (n_bands=8 worse); iter-3 0.0 (n_outer=3 collapse); iter-4 0.2950 (motion_window=3 worse). CONCLUSION: all 3 STRUCTURAL knobs (band count, outer stages, motion window) are at their optimum at iter-1s values; classical structure is exhausted. FAILURE MODE: at fixed structure hr plateaus ~0.30; the TRAINING dynamics are unprobed -- at the very low TPE lr=1.1e-4 the 12 trainable scalars (esp per-band log_band_scale) may not have fully converged in 12 epochs. ONE KNOB: epochs 12 -> 18 (NO param change -> 12 params, ultra-low). Base = iter-1. HYPOTHESIS: if I train 50pct longer at the same low lr, I expect val hr to rise above 0.3009 because the band scales + soft thresholds get more gradient steps to settle into the asymmetric weighting the low-lr regime rewards, WITHOUT the band-runaway overfit that only appeared at the OLD 9x-higher lr past ~12 epochs; risk = mild overfit to the 600 train scenes (hr flat/down) -- if so, epochs<=12 is confirmed optimal. Budget: 819s * 18/12 ~= 1230s ~ 20.5min at 30-min wall.
